quiz.question: At 59.1s in the video, which word best completes the sentence: "Telling you what it thinks the digit is, well the task goes from comically trivial to ________ difficult."?
quiz.questionZh: 在影片 59.1 秒處，講者提到「告訴你它認為數字是什麼，任務從可笑的瑣碎變成了令人畏懼的困難。」，空格中應填入哪個字彙？
quiz.explanation: 原句為：「Telling you what it thinks the digit is, well the task goes from comically trivial to dauntingly difficult.」（告訴你它認為數字是什麼，任務從可笑的瑣碎變成了令人畏懼的困難。）。其中「dauntingly (adv.)」意為「令人畏懼」。

quiz.question: At 311.6s in the video, which word best completes the sentence: "That pattern of ________ causes some very specific pattern in the next layer which causes some pattern in the one after it,."?
quiz.questionZh: 在影片 311.6 秒處，講者提到「這種活化模式會在下一層產生一些非常特定的模式，從而在下一層產生一些模式。」，空格中應填入哪個字彙？
quiz.explanation: 原句為：「That pattern of activations causes some very specific pattern in the next layer which causes some pattern in the one after it,.」（這種活化模式會在下一層產生一些非常特定的模式，從而在下一層產生一些模式。）。其中「activation (n./v.)」意為「激活」。

quiz.question: At 582.8s in the video, which word best completes the sentence: "Now if we made the weights ________ with almost all of the pixels zero except for some positive weights in this region that we care about,."?
quiz.questionZh: 在影片 582.8 秒處，講者提到「現在，如果我們將與幾乎所有像素相關的權重設為零，除了我們關心的該區域中的一些正權重之外。」，空格中應填入哪個字彙？
quiz.explanation: 原句為：「Now if we made the weights associated with almost all of the pixels zero except for some positive weights in this region that we care about,.」（現在，如果我們將與幾乎所有像素相關的權重設為零，除了我們關心的該區域中的一些正權重之外。）。其中「associat (v./adj.)」意為「合夥人」。

quiz.question: At 828.4s in the video, which word best completes the sentence: "Then organize all of the weights as a matrix, where each row of that matrix ________ to the connections between one layer and a particular neuron in the next layer."?
quiz.questionZh: 在影片 828.4 秒處，講者提到「然後將所有權重組織為一個矩陣，其中矩陣的每一行對應於一層與下一層中特定神經元之間的連接。」，空格中應填入哪個字彙？
quiz.explanation: 原句為：「Then organize all of the weights as a matrix, where each row of that matrix corresponds to the connections between one layer and a particular neuron in the next layer.」（然後將所有權重組織為一個矩陣，其中矩陣的每一行對應於一層與下一層中特定神經元之間的連接。）。其中「correspond (n./v.)」意為「對應」。
